episodes.title: Blaze of Glory, Part 1
episodes.summary: Blaze and his driver AJ are introduced to a world of racing Monster Machines! When a truck named Crusher uses dirty tricks to try and win the Championship Race, Blaze will do everything he can to help his friends beat Crusher!

episodes.title: Blaze of Glory, Part 2
episodes.summary: Blaze and his driver AJ are introduced to a world of racing Monster Machines!

episodes.title: The Driving Force
episodes.summary: When Starla, the friendly cowgirl truck, loses one of her pistons Blaze and AJ set out to get it back. But they'll have to hurry before Crusher gets his greedy tires on it!

episodes.title: Tool Duel
episodes.summary: Gabby is the mechanic all the Monster Machines in town count on to fix them up. But when Crusher steals all her tools, Gabby needs Blaze's help to get them back!

episodes.title: Bouncy Tires
episodes.summary: When Zeg the dinosaur truck accidentally puts on a set of "Super Bouncy Tires," he bounces out of control! Now Blaze and AJ have to experiment to find a substance adhesive enough to stop their bouncing buddy.

episodes.title: Epic Sail
episodes.summary: Crusher and Pickle challenge Blaze and his friends to a sailboat race. But when he tries to cheat, Crusher accidentally crashes both ships onto a tropical island!

episodes.title: Stuntmania!
episodes.summary: Darington has built the ultimate stunt-track, and every Monster Machine in town is coming to see the show! But when a jealous Crusher tricks Darington and sends him far, far away, it's up to Blaze and AJ to rescue him.

episodes.title: The Jungle Horn
episodes.summary: Stripes loves his jungle horn, a special instrument that can summon all the animals in the jungle. But when a jealous Crusher steals it, Blaze and Stripes must speed after him in a wild chase to get it back.

episodes.title: The Team Truck Challenge
episodes.summary: It's the day of the Team Truck Challenge, a race where all the trucks get to compete in teams of two! But when Crusher chooses a new partner instead of Pickle, his disappointed sidekick teams up with Blaze to prove his mettle.

episodes.title: Cake-tastrophe!
episodes.summary: When a hungry Crusher accidentally turns the baker truck's baker bots to messy mode, they sprout wheels and drive away! It's up to AJ and Blaze to track down all the rampaging robots before Axle City is blanketed in baked goods.

episodes.title: Truckball Team-Up
episodes.summary: Blaze discovers an exciting new sport called Truckball. But when Crusher and his team of cronies challenge him, Blaze must scour all of Axle City to put together a Truckball team before the big game.

episodes.title: The Mystery Bandit
episodes.summary: When a mysterious bandit makes off with Blaze's metallic trophy, he must track down the culprit in this preschool whodunit!

episodes.title: Gasquatch
episodes.summary: Blaze and AJ are deep in the woods when they discover and befriend a mud-loving monster truck named Gasquatch. Now, they must set out on an epic adventure to bring their new friend to Mud Fest… the muddiest party of all time.

episodes.title: Truck Rangers
episodes.summary: Blaze and his friends have joined the Truck Rangers, a scouting club where trucks earn badges for their accomplishments. But when Crusher's selfish scouting lands everyone in a heap of trouble, Blaze must race to the rescue!

episodes.title: Trouble at the Truck Wash
episodes.summary: When Crusher overloads Gabby's Truck Wash with too much soap, its pieces explode out into Axle City! Blaze and AJ must embark on a quest to track down the missing pieces and rebuild the Truck Wash, so his friends can get clean.

episodes.title: Zeg and the Egg
episodes.summary: Zeg is out smashing things with Blaze and AJ when he finds a tiny dinosaur egg. Now the three friends must embark on an epic journey across a prehistoric landscape to return the egg to its Truckodactyl mother.

episodes.title: Runaway Rocket
episodes.summary: When Crusher tries to cheat at a carnival game, he accidentally strands himself and Pickle on a giant rocket! Now it's up to Blaze and AJ to rescue the two trucks before their runaway rocket crashes into the garbage dump.

episodes.title: Cattle Drive
episodes.summary: When Blaze and Starla encounter a herd of cows wandering out in the desert, they must embark on a wild west adventure to bring them back to Starla's barn.

episodes.title: Dragon Island Duel
episodes.summary: It's the day of the Dragon Island Duel, a race around tropical Dragon Island! But when Crusher cheats and sends Blaze away before the race, AJ must set out to rescue his best friend and bring him back to the starting line.

episodes.title: Sneezing Cold
episodes.summary: Gabby, Blaze and AJ are out in the wilderness when they get a call – Blaze's friends have come down with a sickness called the Sneezles! Our heroes must race back to Axle City to bring the sick trucks the medicine oil they need.

episodes.title: Fired Up!
episodes.summary: When Blaze smells smoke at Axle City's garage, he calmly and courageously leads his friends outside to safety. Axle City's fire chief is impressed with Blaze's courage and thinks maybe he has what it takes to be a fire fighter.

episodes.title: Dino Dash
episodes.summary: Blaze and AJ are playing with their friend Zeg when he accidentally gets blasted by a geyser into a far away mud pit. It's up to Blaze and AJ to save him, using engineering design inspired by their new dinosaur-truck friends.

episodes.title: Truck or Treat
episodes.summary: It's Halloween in Axle City, and Blaze, AJ, and all of their friends are excited to "Truck or Treat." But when Crusher tries to steal all of their candy, his plan goes awry, and he sends their treats far, far away from Axle City. Now Blaze and his friends must race to get to their candy before Crusher!

episodes.title: Race to the Top of the World, Part 1
episodes.summary: Blaze and his friends compete in the most epic race in history: the Race to the Top of the World! But when Crusher throws them off course, Blaze and his Monster Machine friends must persevere to make it to the finish line, meeting pirates and the Sphinx on their journey to the top the world.

episodes.title: Race to the Top of the World, Part 2
episodes.summary: Blaze and his friends compete in the most epic race in history: the Race to the Top of the World! But when Crusher throws them off course, Blaze and his Monster Machine friends must persevere to make it to the finish line.

episodes.title: Monster Machine Christmas
episodes.summary: It's Christmas Eve, and Blaze and AJ are helping Santa load his magic bag of presents to deliver all over the world. But Crusher accidently knocks over the bag and sends the presents flying.

episodes.title: Knight Riders
episodes.summary: Blaze and Crusher discover a medieval kingdom holding a Royal Race! The two trucks become knights to compete in the race across the realm. But even though Sir Blaze is the speediest knight of all, Crusher's cheats won't make it easy to win.

episodes.title: Darington to the Moon!
episodes.summary: Today Darington will attempt his biggest stunt yet: rocketing to the moon! But there's just one problem. His battery-powered rocket is out of energy. To get to the moon Blaze must help Darington recharge his battery.

episodes.title: Piggy 500
episodes.summary: It's the day of the Piggy 500, and Starla is excited to race with her prize pig, Zippy, in a team race. But when her competitor Crusher and his rude pig, Slop, cheat and send Zippy far away, it's up to Blaze, AJ, and Starla to find him.

episodes.title: Spark Bug
episodes.summary: Blaze, Stripes, and AJ are racing through the jungle when Stripes discovers a lost little fire beetle named Sparky. Blaze and his friends set off across the jungle to help Sparky get back home to the top of a red hot volcano.

episodes.title: Five Alarm Blaze
episodes.summary: There's a fire on the bridge, and it's too much for the Fire Chief and his team to handle. They need Firefighting Blaze to help. With time running out, Blaze hurries across town. But can he get to the bridge in time?

episodes.title: Axle City Grand Prix
episodes.summary: Gabby has the perfect tool to get Blaze ready to race: a special remote that can control any machine. But when Crusher takes her remote, he activates machines all over town to slow Blaze down.

episodes.title: Treasure Track
episodes.summary: Blaze, AJ, and Gabby join Pegwheel the Pirate-Truck for an island treasure hunt! Following their treasure map, the friends search jungle beaches and mountains to find where X marks the spot.

episodes.title: Rocket Ski Rescue
episodes.summary: Crusher's Grammy is in town to watch Crusher and Blaze race at the Monster Dome. But when Crusher tries to cheat using rocket skis, his plan backfires, blasting him off the racetrack and across Axle City!

episodes.title: Dinosaur Parade
episodes.summary: Blaze, AJ, and lots of spectators have gathered to watch herds of dinosaurs march through Axle City! But when Crusher pushes his way into the parade, he scatters dinos everywhere, and it's up to Blaze, AJ, and Zeg to find and rescue them.

episodes.title: Race Car Superstar
episodes.summary: Blaze and AJ visit VelocityVille, a town full of race cars where everybody loves to go fast! But when a snooty car named Speedrick traps all the other racers, Blaze must transform into a super-fast race car to free his new friends.

episodes.title: Race to Eagle Rock
episodes.summary: Blaze brings all of his monster truck pals to VelocityVille for a wild race to the top of Eagle Rock! But Crusher will stop at nothing to beat race car Blaze and friends, setting traps to slow them down.

episodes.title: Sky Track
episodes.summary: Swoops the helicopter loses his rotor, and without it he can't fly! It's time for Blaze and AJ to retrieve the runaway rotor, adventuring up onto The Sky Track, an amazing course that weaves through the clouds.

episodes.title: The Wishing Wheel
episodes.summary: Blaze, AJ, and Stripes are searching for the Wishing Wheel: a magical treasure that will grant a wish for one lucky race car. But with chomping, stomping, and slithering dangers at every turn, can Blaze and his friends stay on track?

episodes.title: Pickle Power
episodes.summary: Crusher builds a super-powered vacuum to clean up his big mess – but the machine goes haywire, sucking up Crusher and everything in its path! Now Pickle must team up with Blaze and AJ to stop the vacuum and save Crusher.

episodes.title: Dinocoaster
episodes.summary: Zeg has a ticket to ride a brand new dinosaur roller coaster: the Dinocoaster! But when the ticket blows away, it's up to Blaze to help his buddy track it down and get back to the amusement park in time.

episodes.title: The Hundred Mile Race
episodes.summary: Blaze visits VelocityVille to compete with his new racecar pals in the longest race ever: the Hundred Mile Race! But Crusher is racing too, and he'll do anything to win.

episodes.title: The Polar Derby
episodes.summary: Blaze and his friends head to VelocityVille and transform into racecars for the Polar Derby, a wintry race through the snow! But when racecar Crusher knocks them off-course, the pals must keep cool to stay on track.

episodes.title: Light Riders
episodes.summary: When a light thief steals all the lights from Axle City, Blaze is outfitted with special lights to help him track down the thief and restore the missing lights.

episodes.title: Catch That Cake!
episodes.summary: It's Darington's birthday! Crusher uses a robot plate to try and steal the birthday cake, but his plan goes awry and the cake goes rocketing away. Will Blaze catch the runaway cake before Crusher and save the party?

episodes.title: The Bouncing Bull Racetrack
episodes.summary: Blaze and Starla discover a map that leads to a track of legend – the Bouncing Bull Racetrack! The friends set out on a Wild West quest to find the track and take the ride of their lives.

episodes.title: Mega Mud Robot
episodes.summary: Gasquatch is back! He's been saving up his money to buy the ultimate toy… a Mega Mud Robot. But when his coins go missing, it's up to Blaze to help his mud-loving friend recover them before the toy store closes.

episodes.title: Knighty Knights
episodes.summary: In the kingdom of knight-trucks, Blaze discovers a machine his medieval pals use to recharge. But when a dragon snatches the charging station, Blaze leads a quest to recover the machine before everyone in the kingdom runs out of energy.

episodes.title: Animal Island
episodes.summary: Blaze and Stripes sail to Animal Island - an incredible place inhabited by monster truck animals! But when a greedy lizard puts the island in peril, Blaze and Stripes must find their wild side to save their animal friends.

episodes.title: Toucan Do It!
episodes.summary: Blaze, Starla, and Darington can't wait to play every animal's favorite sport: Jungle Ball! But when their teammate Tooks the Toucan gets launched from the stadium, it's up to the friends to get her back in the game.

episodes.title: Falcon Quest
episodes.summary: In the sky above Animal Island, a remarkable race is about to begin. But before Blaze can join, he must spread his wings! Challenged by a tough-talking falcon, Blaze takes off on an aerial journey to earn his place with the fastest fliers.

episodes.title: The Big Ant-venture
episodes.summary: Blaze and Zeg are on Animal Island when they discover a world of tiny creatures right under their tires: Insect City! The friends transform into a super-strong ant and a bouncy grasshopper for their littlest big adventure yet!

episodes.title: Ready, Set, Roar!
episodes.summary: Blaze and Stripes transform into ferociously fast jungle cats to race in the Animal Island Championship! But to win, they'll have to beat Crusher disguised as a cheating cheetah. Can they claw their way to victory?

episodes.title: The Great Animal Crown
episodes.summary: When the Great Animal Crown is lost at the bottom of the ocean, Blaze transforms into a super-fast shark to retrieve it for his Animal Island friends. But he'll have to swim fast – or Crusher maidiy get to the crown first.

episodes.title: Tow Truck Tough
episodes.summary: Blaze transforms into a tow-truck, and, with the help of AJ and Gabby, sets off on a tow-tally awesome adventure to save Stripes.

episodes.title: Race for the Golden Treasure
episodes.summary: Blaze and Pegwheel the Pirate have teamed up for the ultimate treasure hunt! Together they must find three keys to unlock a special chest. But Crusher's sailing the high seas too, and he'll do anything to get the treasure.

episodes.title: Need for Blazing Speed
episodes.summary: When Crusher tries to get Blazing Speed for himself, he accidentally sends Blaze's engine flying! Now it's Blaze vs. Crusher in a race for Blazing Speed – but without an engine, Blaze must find new ways to propel himself to victory.

episodes.title: Fast Friends
episodes.summary: Blaze, AJ, and Gabby meet a brand new monster machine named Watts – a super fast truck with electric tires! But when one of her special tires goes rolling into the jungle, Blaze, AJ, and Gabby promise to help her get it back.

episodes.title: Raceday Rescue
episodes.summary: It's race day, and Crusher is cheating twice as hard to beat Blaze and Watts - sending both drivers far, far away! But Blaze and Watts are determined to save AJ and Gabby and get back to the race in time to win!

episodes.title: Defeat the Cheat
episodes.summary: It's the second ever Team Truck Challenge - a big race that pairs trucks together in racing teams. And this time Blaze's teammate is...Crusher?! Will Crusher be able to resist his cheating ways to win for the very first time?

episodes.title: Darington Saves the Circus
episodes.summary: Blaze, AJ, and Darington are in the front row for the amazing Chicken Circus! But when Crusher accidentally launches the chickens far, far away, it's up to Blaze and Darington to get their feathered friends back to the big top!

episodes.title: The Pickle Family Campout
episodes.summary: When all the members of Pickle's family get lost in the woods, Pickle teams up with Tow Truck Blaze to come to their rescue!

episodes.title: Robot Power
episodes.summary: When Crusher unleashes three of his most destructive creations on Axle City, there's only one hero strong enough to save the day: Robot Blaze!

episodes.title: Breaking the Ice
episodes.summary: When a little bunny gets trapped on top of a melting glacier, Blaze must put his new robot powers to the test as he races to the rescue.

episodes.title: Robots to the Rescue
episodes.summary: When three big emergencies turn out to be too much for one truck alone, Blaze turns himself and his friends into super strong robots to save Axle City from a runaway train, an overflowing glue factory, and an erupting volcano!

episodes.title: The Supersize Prize
episodes.summary: At the Axle City Fair, Blaze and AJ realize they don't have enough coins to use the new Supersize Prize Machine. So to earn money, Blaze gets three different jobs, transforming into super-cool vehicles to take care of business.

episodes.title: T-Rex Trouble
episodes.summary: In Dinosaur Valley, Blaze and Zeg show off their amazing robot powers to their dinosaur friends; when they discover three lost little tyrannosauruses, they must use their robot powers to get the babies home safely.

episodes.title: Meatball Mayhem
episodes.summary: When Crusher accidentally knocks a bottle of "grow spice" onto a meatball, it grows to an enormous size and rolls away! It's up to Blaze and Pickle to transform into robots and stop the meatball before it wrecks the entire town!

episodes.title: Robots in Space
episodes.summary: When Space Commander Megan is marooned on Pluto, our robot heroes will race through wormholes, shoot past ice volcanoes, and blast straight through an asteroid field to bring their new friend back home.

episodes.title: Power Tires!
episodes.summary: When his tires get popped, Blaze thinks he's out of the race for good. Luckily, Gabby is there with a new set of Power Tires – high-tech wheels that can transform into anything Blaze needs to keep rolling.

episodes.title: Ninja Blaze
episodes.summary: Ninja Master Blackbelt is training Blaze and AJ to be powerful ninjas when Crusher and Pickle accidentally launch themselves onto an icy mountain! Now Blaze and AJ must use their new ninjas skills to rescue them.

episodes.title: Snow Day Showdown
episodes.summary: It's a snowy day in Axle City, and every truck in town is lining up for a delicious winter warm-up: hot chocolate! But when Crusher tries to take all the hot chocolate for himself, Blaze is in hot pursuit to get it back!

episodes.title: Construction Crew to the Rescue
episodes.summary: When Crusher and Pickle are trapped at the top of a tall, rickety tower, Blaze, Stripes, and Starla transform into awesome construction vehicles to build a way down.

episodes.title: Officer Blaze
episodes.summary: Blaze and AJ are joining the police department! With the help of their new police pal Officer Anna, Blaze transforms into a super-fast police car to lend a helping hand (or tire) to any truck in trouble.

episodes.title: The Flying Lion
episodes.summary: Blaze and AJ are excited to play with their new friend Roarian, the Flying Lion! But when Roarian loses his magical sunstone, he turns into a statue! Now it's up to Blaze and AJ to find the sunstone and restore Roarian's powers!

episodes.title: Royal Rescue
episodes.summary: A visit to the King's castle goes awry when the King accidentally catapults himself far, far away! To bring him home, Blaze, AJ, and the King's adorable pet dragon Zeek must transform into knights in shining armor!

episodes.title: The 100 Egg Challenge
episodes.summary: The Great Egg Hunt has just begun, and Blaze and Crusher are racing all over town to see who can find the most eggs. Only the first truck to collect 100 eggs will win the egg-ceptionally tasty chocolate trophy!

episodes.title: Ninja Soup
episodes.summary: Blackbelt isn't the only Ninja Master in his family — his Grandma Ninja has awesome moves too! But when she gets a nasty cold, Blaze, AJ, and Blackbelt set out to make the most powerful medicine there is: Ninja Soup!

episodes.title: Blaze and the Magic Genie
episodes.summary: Blaze and AJ are driving through the desert when they meet a magical genie, who loves to grant wishes! But when the genie loses the jewels that give him his powers, Blaze and AJ go on a quest to get them back!

episodes.title: The Midnight Mile
episodes.summary: It may be nighttime in Axle City, but all the trucks are staying up super late for the ultimate all-night race: the Midnight Mile! And the first truck to cross the finish line will win the Glow-in-the-Dark trophy!

episodes.title: The Island of Lost Treasure
episodes.summary: Somewhere, on The Island of Lost Treasure, there are incredible riches just waiting to be discovered. And Blaze and Darington are determined to be the first to find them!

episodes.title: AJ to the Rescue
episodes.summary: Blaze and AJ are racing through the jungle when Blaze gets trapped in super sticky mud! Now it's up to AJ and his new animal friends to go on an epic adventure to save Blaze!

episodes.title: The Trophy Chase
episodes.summary: The Championship Race is about to start, and all the fastest trucks in town are ready to roll! But when Crusher steals the trophy before the race even begins, it's up to Blaze and his friends to get it back in time.

episodes.title: Babysitting Heroes
episodes.summary: Blaze and AJ are helping their friend Stripes look after some baby animals, when the little critters accidentally float away on big bubbles. Now, it's up to these three babysitters to find their adorable animal friends and save the day!

episodes.title: Abra-ka-pickle!
episodes.summary: Pickle is putting on a magic show for all of Axle City! But when Crusher accidentally makes a magical mistake, it's up to Blaze and Pickle to fix the magic and save their friends! Abra-ka-Pickle!

episodes.title: Toy Trouble!
episodes.summary: The Axle City toy store has an amazing machine that can make any toy you want! But when Crusher uses it, he makes giant toys that run amok! Only Blaze and Watts can stop the giant toys from making a giant mess!

episodes.title: Deep Sea Grand Prix
episodes.summary: For the first time ever, Blaze and AJ are racing under the ocean! Blaze transforms into a submarine and speeds through sunken ships and coral reefs to reach the giant sand castle at the finish line!

episodes.title: Recycling Power!
episodes.summary: When Axle City is visited by a littering raccoon, it's up to Blaze to save the day as a Super Recycling Truck! He cleans up the town and rescues his friends – just in time for a final showdown with the Litter Critter!

episodes.title: The Great Space Race
episodes.summary: Blaze and AJ take off into space for a race that's out of this world! Along the way to Planet Victory, they meet friendly aliens, dodge asteroids, and face off against Crusher's space ship!

episodes.title: Ice Cream Monster Machine
episodes.summary: Gasquatch invites Blaze and AJ to his ice cream party! But he forgot something important – the ice cream! So, Blaze transforms into an Ice Cream Truck and races to reach Gasquatch's house in time!

episodes.title: The Mechanic Team!
episodes.summary: Blaze stops into Gabby's Garage for a quick repair – just as she gets an alert! Three far-flung trucks need her mechanical know-how! So, Blaze and AJ volunteer to help her take her garage on the go!

episodes.title: Blazing Amazing Stories
episodes.summary: Blaze and AJ are babysitting for Baby Gherkin! When it's time for her nap, they tell her three epic bedtime stories about police, cowboys, and superheroes – all starring Blaze and his friends!

episodes.title: Big Rig Blaze
episodes.summary: When a windstorm blows away the supplies for Stripes' Animal Party, Blaze transforms into the one Monster Machine strong enough to haul it all back – a Big Rig! There's nothing he can't pull with that Big Rig Force!

episodes.title: The Big Balloon Rescue
episodes.summary: All of Axle City is enjoying the Balloon Fair – until Crusher and Pickle get stuck on a runaway hot-air balloon! Now it's up to Blaze and AJ to rescue their high-flying friends… before they crash into the Slime Volcano!

episodes.title: Space Alien Adventure!
episodes.summary: Blaze and AJ make friends with a space alien named Gormy! But when Gormy's jetpack loses power, they set out to help him find six special space batteries so he can fly home to his alien family!

episodes.title: Video Game Heroes
episodes.summary: Blaze and AJ are super excited to play their new video game. But when a video game wizard makes the game come alive, Blaze and AJ must level up and save Axle City from pixel pandemonium!

episodes.title: The Race Around the Earth
episodes.summary: In their biggest race ever, Blaze and AJ go head-to-head against Crusher to race all the way around the Earth and win the World's Biggest Trophy!

episodes.title: The Blaze Family
episodes.summary: Blaze and AJ are spending the day with some very special trucks: Blaze's family! His Mom, Dad, and little sister Sparkle join Blaze in a race against Crusher to prove they're the world's fastest family!

episodes.title: The Treat Thief
episodes.summary: Officer Blaze just got his biggest case yet: tracking down the mischievous Treat Thief! With help from Officer Anna, Blaze sets out to stop the thief and recover every stolen treat!

episodes.title: Big Rig to the Rescue!
episodes.summary: When three big deliveries are needed all over Axle City, there's only one monster machine with the power to haul it all: Big Rig Blaze! But even Big Rig Blaze may not be able to make all the deliveries in time.

episodes.title: Dino Derby
episodes.summary: Dinosaur Blaze is teaming up with his prehistoric pal Zeg to compete in… the Dino Derby! But will this dino duo have what it takes to outrace the rest and become Dino Derby champions?

episodes.title: The Amazing Stunt Kitty
episodes.summary: When a big stunt goes awry, Darington is sent flying away on an out-of-control balloon! It's up to Blaze, AJ, and Darington's sidekick Stunt Kitty to save the day!

episodes.title: Sir Blaze and the Unicorn
episodes.summary: Witness the return of Sir Blaze and Sir AJ as they embark on an epic quest to free a magical unicorn from an unpoppable bubble!

episodes.title: Sparkle's Racing Badge
episodes.summary: It's more Blaze family fun in this high octane, action-packed adventure as Blaze and his sister Sparkle team up to make it back to the Monster Dome in time for a big race.

episodes.title: Race to Sky High Mountain
episodes.summary: At the starting line for the Race to Sky High Mountain, one of Crusher's cheats threatens to sideline Blaze for good. To get back in this race, Blaze will need… Power Tires!

episodes.title: The Puppy Chase!
episodes.summary: When a big bubble floats away with Gabby's new puppy, she'll team up with Blaze and AJ to get him back.

episodes.title: The Gold Medal Games
episodes.summary: It's time for the Gold Medal Games, and Blaze is ready to compete! But when Crusher cheats and sends his rival flying far away, Blaze has to speed back to Axle City to beat the buzzer and win that medal!

episodes.title: Firefighters to the Rescue!
episodes.summary: When three fire emergencies break out across Axle City, it's up to Blaze to put 'em out – and to do it, he'll transform into the most epic fire rescue vehicles we've ever seen!

episodes.title: The Treasure of the Broken Key: A Musical Adventure
Sparkle's Big Rescue
episodes.summary: When Crusher sends Blaze away with one of his latest cheats, Blaze's little sister Sparkle comes to save the day and bring her brother back in time so they can race together to win the Teamwork Trophy

episodes.title: The Baby Robot From Outer Space
Super Wheels vs. The Green Queen
Video Game Land: A Monster Machine Super Special
episodes.summary: Crusher and Blaze find themselves stuck in a video game; they must defeat all the levels to go home.

episodes.title: Christmas Power!: A Monster Machine Super Special (1)
Christmas Power!: A Monster Machine Super Special (2)
